description: Authority hierarchy and memory boundary rules for Halal Trading OS Agent Runtime

L0_SYSTEM.name: System / Authority
L0_SYSTEM.description: Trading OS rules, Decision Log, governance, risk constraints, and active strategy limits.

L1_KNOWLEDGE.name: Knowledge Vault
L1_KNOWLEDGE.description: SOPs, strategy playbooks, indicators, research papers, and execution journals.

L2_SESSION.name: Session / Conversation Context
L2_SESSION.description: Current prompt, intermediate tool outputs, active turn context, and execution trace.

L3_PERSISTENT.name: Persistent Agent Memory
L3_PERSISTENT.description: User interaction preferences, workflow state, and recurring pattern history.

conflict_resolution.description: If lower rank context contradicts a higher rank rule, lower rank is discarded as noise.
